{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total number of rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (re-tested patients)
df_retested = df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]
print(f"Number of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1): {len(df_retested)}")

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {patient_sample_counts.max()}")
print(f"Patients with multiple sample_seq: {patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1].count()}")"}
